message.content: Hey, I need to send a quick text to Min-jun. He's bringing the reference books for my final studio review tomorrow. Can you draft a polite message thanking him and confirming I'll be at the usual café spot at 2 PM?

content.text: Sure thing. Here is a draft: "Hi Min-jun, thanks so much for bringing the reference books over. I really appreciate it. I'll be waiting at our usual café spot at 2 PM tomorrow. See you then!" Does that sound good to you?

message.content: Yes, that works. Send it. Also, remind me what time my part-time shift starts? I'm trying to fit in a hike before I go in.

content.text: Your shift at the café starts at 4 PM. Since it's Sunday, the weather looks clear. Do you still want to go to Namsan Trail as planned?

message.content: No, I changed my mind. I'm going to Bukhansan Peak instead. The views are better this time of year.

content.text: Got it. Bukhansan Peak it is. Just a heads-up, the trail is steeper than the city parks, so wear your sturdy boots. Do you need me to look up the bus route to the trailhead?

message.content: No, I know the way. Actually, while I'm thinking about it, if I were to stop by a specific coffee place near the summit to celebrate finishing my project, I'd probably pick Daehangno Roastery. Just an idea, nothing changes.

content.text: Noted as a hypothetical preference. I won't add it to any lists or bookings. Do you need anything else before you head out? Maybe a grocery list for dinner tonight?

message.content: Yes, please. I need to make something simple for dinner. Just list eggs, spinach, and tofu. Keep it under 10,000 won if possible.

content.text: Here is your shopping list: eggs, spinach, tofu. Based on current prices at the local market, this should cost around 8,500 won. Safe hike, Ji-woo!
